verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਮਨੁ ਆਠ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਪਾਂਚ ਟੂਕ ਟੂਕ ਟੂਕ ਚਾਰਿ ਫਾਰਿ ਫਾਰਿ ਦੋਇ ਫਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ek man aaTh kha(n)dd kha(n)dd kha(n)dd paa(n)ch Took Took Took chaar faar faar dhoi faar hai ||

en.bdb: One maund is divided into eight parts. Each part is five seer, which is divided into four parts. Each quarter is a pao. (All the weight measures mentioned are old Punjabi weight measures).

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾਹੂ ਤੇ ਪਈਸੇ ਅਉ ਪਈਸਾ ਏਕ ਪਾਂਚ ਟਾਂਕ ਟਾਂਕ ਟਾਂਕ ਮਾਸੇ ਚਾਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: taahoo te pieese aau pieesaa ek paa(n)ch Taa(n)k Taa(n)k Taa(n)k maase chaar anik prakaar hai ||

en.bdb: These half paos are then reduced to Sarsahi. Each Sarsahi contains five Tank. Each Tank has four Mashas. Thus these weight measures have much spread.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਸਾ ਏਕ ਆਠ ਰਤੀ ਰਤੀ ਆਠ ਚਾਵਰ ਕੀ ਹਾਟ ਹਾਟ ਕਨੁ ਕਨੁ ਤੋਲ ਤੁਲਾਧਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: maasaa ek aaTh ratee ratee aaTh chaavar kee haaT haaT kan kan tol tulaadhaar hai ||

en.bdb: One masha contains eight ratis (a small red and black seed of Allarams, used as a weight measure by jewellers for weighing gold) and one rati has eight grains of rice. Thus are being weighed items in a shop.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰ ਪੁਰ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਏਤੋ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੨੨੯॥
verses.translit_en: pur pur poor rahe sakal sa(n)saar bikhai bas aavai kaise jaa ko eto bisathaar hai ||229||

en.bdb: This is the spread of a maund in the cities of the world. A mind which has such an expanse of lust, anger, avarice attachment, arrogance, desires and other vices, how can that mind be controlled? (229)
